chunks: Jamīl ibn Darrāj said to him:
The ship is close to the shore, so should I go out and perform salat (prayer)? He said: "Perform salat (prayer) in it. Are you not content with the salat (prayer) of Nūḥ (عليه السلام)?"

key_terms.السَّفِينَةُ: the ship on which the worshipper is traveling
key_terms.الْجُدِّ: the shore or riverbank near the vessel
key_terms.بِصَلَاةِ: with the prayer; referring here to the prayer of Nūḥ عليه السلام
key_terms.نُوحٍ: Prophet Nūḥ عليه السلام, cited as the precedent

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) on a ship when it is near the shore?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing salat (prayer) on a ship when it is near the shore. The Imam عليه السلام permits praying on the ship itself and invokes the example of Nūḥ عليه السلام, indicating the legitimacy and sufficiency of such prayer.
